snippet.description:

I’ve officially signed my first professional football contract abroad.

This video captures the moment everything became real — signing the contract, taking in what this opportunity means, and preparing for a completely new chapter of life and football.

The journey to get here hasn’t always been straightforward, which makes this moment even more special. New country, new club, new challenges and a lot to prove.

We’re moving abroad, and I’m excited to bring you along for everything that comes next — from life in the UAE to training, matchdays and the reality of playing professional football abroad.

This is only the beginning.

Thank you to everyone who’s supported the journey so far. ❤️
